WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
    COUNT(*) as total_observatories
  FROM telescope_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.telescope_count,
    tc.telescope_count * 1.0 / gs.total_telescopes as share,
    1.0 / gs.total_observatories as average_share
  FROM telescope_counts tc,
  global_stats gs
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    telescope_count,
    share,
    average_share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > average_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) as average_excess
FROM above_average
